Definition: to drip, or shed by trickling
BiblicalUsage: 1) to flow, distil, flow forth or down, trickle, drop; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to flow; 1a1a) streams, floods (participle); 1a2) to distil; 1b) (Hiphil) to cause to flow
